notes.title: Construction Update - Dig VR now launching May 1st!
notes.notes:
Like any real construction project, sometimes you need a little extra time to get things just right. That’s why we’re pushing back the completion date for Dig VR on PSVR2 & Steam VR.

New Expected Finish Date: May 1st (Previously March 20th)

[previewyoutube=LaC_KEimTJo;full][/previewyoutube]

We know you’re excited to grab your virtual shovel and start digging, but good things take time, especially when we want to deliver the best possible experience. A few extra buckets full of work will ensure that Dig VR launches with the polish, performance, and immersion you deserve.

Thank you for your patience and support! We can’t wait for you to jump in and start digging when Dig VR officially launches on May 1st.

Stay tuned for more updates, and in the meantime, keep those hard hats ready!

- The Dig VR Team
